pages.title: Making Damascus Steel
pages.text: Make this alloy in an Alloyer:$(br2)1 Iron + 2 Bronze = 3 Damascus Steel

pages.title: Alloying Notes
pages.text: Supply furnace fuel and the complete ingredient amounts. Most alloy inputs accept ingots or dusts; the Angmallen fallback uses matching forms. Loaded recipes can change these stock equations.

pages.title: Default Tool Stats
pages.text: Durability: 395 uses.$(br)Harvest level: 3.$(br)Mining efficiency: 6.0.$(br)Material damage bonus: 2.5.$(br)Enchantability: 27.$(br2)These are the supplied material values. The item type, enchantments, and active traits affect final performance.

pages.title: Default Armor Stats
pages.text: Protection: helmet 3, chestplate 6, leggings 5, boots 3.$(br2)Toughness per piece: 0.0.$(br)Enchantability: 27.

pages.title: Armor: Royal Blood
pages.text: A minion will be spawned to aid you in your fights against enemies (minion health will scale with the armor count)

pages.title: Pickaxe: Dazzle
pages.text: Mining ores sometimes grants a bit of experience depending on the harvest level.
